Components

Picker

Selection is a machine; openness is the platform's. The listbox is a popover the trigger commands — light dismiss, top layer and the invoker's expanded state are browser primitives, so the open/close half ships zero markup beyond two attributes.

The row

The choice, its readout label and every option's aria-selected are columns of one tab-tier row.

choice: apple · label: Apple

The machine

Six generated arrows, every assign a literal — the option list is the state set.

{
  "field": "choice",
  "initial": "apple",
  "context": {
    "label": "Apple",
    "sel_apple": "true",
    "sel_banana": "false",
    "sel_cherry": "false"
  },
  "on": {
    "click@picker_demo-trigger-apple": {
      "target": "apple",
      "assign": {
        "label": "Apple",
        "sel_apple": "true",
        "sel_banana": "false",
        "sel_cherry": "false"
      }
    },
    "click@picker_demo-trigger-banana": {
      "target": "banana",
      "assign": {
        "label": "Banana",
        "sel_apple": "false",
        "sel_banana": "true",
        "sel_cherry": "false"
      }
    },
    "click@picker_demo-trigger-cherry": {
      "target": "cherry",
      "assign": {
        "label": "Cherry",
        "sel_apple": "false",
        "sel_banana": "false",
        "sel_cherry": "true"
      }
    }
  },
  "states": {
    "apple": {
      "on": {
        "click@picker_demo-trigger-apple": []
      }
    },
    "banana": {
      "on": {
        "click@picker_demo-trigger-banana": []
      }
    },
    "cherry": {
      "on": {
        "click@picker_demo-trigger-cherry": []
      }
    }
  }
}
